title: Page shell
purpose: The canonical order every page starts from: skip-link, gov-banner, site-alert, header, main, footer.

title: Landing page
purpose: A front door: hero with search and a call to action, a stat band, program tiles, a numbered section opener, a row of cards and a summary.

title: Agency homepage
purpose: The department's front door, reimagined: a 16:9 hero with search, a stat band, the priorities as numbered openers, a full-bleed dark identity band (gold cards and an updates field), the newsroom and a summary.

title: Program page
purpose: A long reading page: breadcrumb, title, a sticky in-page nav beside long prose, an FAQ accordion and a dark reference list that blends into the footer.

title: Program office
purpose: A program office's page, aviation-flavored: a dark 16:9 masthead as the office's identity, light reading in the middle (in-page nav beside long prose), then a dark interstitial band that blends through the references into the footer.

title: Article
purpose: A news article: breadcrumb, eyebrow and title, a metadata row, prose with a pull-quote, related items and pagination.

title: Newsroom
purpose: A press index: the display heading, toggle-chip filters, a six-item collection with mixed thumbnails, pagination, and the media contacts on a raised band.

title: Press release
purpose: A press release: eyebrow, heading, the contact and release-number block, the body, and the documents that go with it.

title: Data page
purpose: A statistics page: headline numbers, a sortable table that stacks on narrow screens, the downloads, and the sources.

title: Multi-page form
purpose: One page of a journey: the step indicator, an error summary, the form laid out by the form pattern rules, the journey actions, a confirm dialog and a toast.

title: Grant application
purpose: Multi-page application journey — steps, sectioned form, error flow, review, confirm.

title: Search results
purpose: Site search: the full-width field, filter chips, a results collection and pagination; then the empty state the same page shows when nothing matches.

title: Emergency notice
purpose: A page that leads with an emergency: the one role=alert band above the header, the list of current alerts, the summary and the steps to take.

title: Assistant
purpose: An AI assistant page: the header, a title, and the whole conversational exchange in a container.

title: Program + assistant
purpose: The assistant embedded in a page type: a program reading page with the conversational exchange scoped into a labeled sunken region between the prose and the FAQ — the same components as the Assistant page, owned by the page instead of owning it.
